evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 sensor is not installed; required growth-atmosphere verification is unavailable.
Growth pressure was 2.999 Torr at approximately 100 sccm Ar.
Pressure has progressively risen to 3.152 Torr despite essentially constant Ar flow; no pressure tolerance or normal-run reference is provided.
Temperature 750.2 C and Ar 100.3 sccm track setpoints, but O2 remains unavailable, so these readings cannot establish acceptable atmosphere.

args.missing_evidence: A functioning, validated exhaust O2 measurement is required to verify the growth atmosphere; pressure acceptance limits or normal-run references would clarify the pressure rise. No sample characterization is available.
